ceilings._token_definition: input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens, summed across every fleet session in ~/.claude/projects/*Madhav*/ whose first message is at or after campaign_started_ts. Measured by bin/spend_meter.py into state/SPEND.jsonl. This is the raw four-class sum; it is dominated by cache_read (~97% of recent volume) and is therefore an AUDIT total, not a cost proxy and not a good runaway detector — see output_tokens_* for the tripwire that binds first in a loop.
ceilings._output_definition: output_tokens only, same sessions and window. Output is the best single proxy for work actually generated: cache_read scales with context size and session count, output scales with generation, so a fleet stuck in a loop trips this before the raw sum.
ceilings._cost_note: The ceiling that actually means money. NULL until state/PRICING.json carries current per-model, per-class rates — the four token classes differ by roughly an order of magnitude in price, so no single token count is a cost proxy. PRAHARI trips on whichever ceiling binds first; a null cost ceiling is simply not one of them yet.

standing_instructions.mutation_restore: REVISED after M0-T38 proved the earlier version insufficient. THE DEFECT IS THE SHAPE OF THE CHECK: 'sha256 == my-own-baseline' is a PROXY ('the file equals my copy') standing in for the CLAIM ('no mutation is present') — with a poisoned baseline it is structurally incapable of returning false. Our own §N.8 class, on the mechanism we use to trust our checks. R1 exclusivity — prefer a per-agent worktree when mutating; removes the class rather than detecting it. R2 PROVE THE BASELINE BEFORE MUTATING: its sha256 must equal the file's HEAD blob or a hash your own previous command printed; if neither, STOP — you have copied a sibling's in-flight state. IF ONLY ONE IS ADOPTED, ADOPT R2. R3 restore verification includes a MARKER SWEEP, not only baseline equality. R4 hash-bracket PRE/POST in one shell invocation for anything you will quote. R5 marker sweep immediately before committing. R6 delete the byte-copy.
standing_instructions.dispatch_isolation: CONDUCTOR CHANGE: mutation-heavy tasks are dispatched WORKTREE-ISOLATED from now on. R1 applied at the dispatch layer rather than asked of each agent — the shared working tree is what made two correct agents corrupt each other, and no amount of per-agent care removes a class that the dispatcher can.
